proposal.reason: Trial 1 word_C0.05 shows balanced class recalls but a large train-search gap. With no lower-C word-only option available, a controlled representation change at the same C is more informative than moving C upward without evidence.
proposal.review: Only one completed primary trial is available; the proposed candidate is untried and no confirmation-split evidence exists. The prior result is evidence, not proof of overfitting or underfitting.
proposal.hypothesis: Adding char n-grams to word features at C=0.05 may capture subword or headline cues not represented by word tokens alone; the effect on primary search accuracy is unknown.
proposal.uncertainty: Single primary trial, no formal test, and no matched split comparison. The observed train-search gap could reflect overfitting or distribution shift, and char features may increase variance. Direction and magnitude of change are not predicted.
